intro: This section is designed to test your ability to recognize language structures that are appropriate in standard written English. The questions in this section belong to two types, each of which has special directions.
directions: DIRECTIONS: Questions 1-15 are partial sentences. Below each sentence you will see four words or phrases, marked (A), (B), (C), and (D). Select the one word or phrase that best completes the sentence. Then, on your answer sheet, find the number of the question and fill in the space that contains the letter for the answer you have chosen. Fill in the space completely.

examples.title: EXAMPLE I
examples.stem: Drying flowers is the best way......them.
explanation_lines: The sentence should state, "Drying flowers is the best way to preserve them." Therefore, the correct answer is (A).

examples.title: EXAMPLE II
examples.stem: Many American universities......as small, private colleges.
explanation_lines: The sentence should state, "Many American universities began as small, private colleges." Therefore, the correct answer is (C). After you read the directions, begin work on the questions.
